  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

  coding for you.

  clearinghouse.

  intelligent, automated payments.

  accuracy.

  requisition to delivery.

[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

## Health Systems Worldwide

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

## Common Questions

### How much experience does AvaSure have in virtual care?+

AvaSure was founded in 2008 and has 18+ years in the virtual care business with 5,000+ deployments
across 1,200+ hospitals, millions of hours of patient monitoring, [150+ case studies,][141] and 21+
peer-reviewed journal articles.

### Does virtual care replace bedside nurses?+

No. Virtual care is designed to support bedside nurses, not replace them. AvaSure’s platform is
purpose-built to blend virtual and in-person touchpoints across a broad range of care settings,
improving both the patient and clinician experience by reducing administrative tasks, lowering
stress, and optimizing care workflows so clinicians can focus on patient outcomes.

### What types of hospitals use virtual care technology?+

Academic medical centers, community hospitals, rural/critical access hospitals, pediatric
facilities, VA facilities, and large multi-state health systems use virtual care technology to
improve staff retention, patient outcomes, and resource utilization, and reduce stress, 1:1 sitter
costs, and workplace violence.

### What clinical use cases does virtual care support?+

Virtual care supports a wide range of clinical use cases like falls prevention, elopement, workplace
violence, virtual nursing, suicide risk, pediatric monitoring, specialty consults,
admission/discharge, and more.

### What hospital care settings can use virtual care?+

Virtual care can be used across a variety of care settings, including patient rooms, critical care
units, pediatrics, emergency departments, behavioral health, operating rooms, and more.

### Can virtual care technology integrate with EHR and nurse call systems?+

Yes. AvaSure integrates with a broad ecosystem of healthcare technology, including EHR systems,
medical devices, vICU platforms, nurse call solutions, middleware, and mobile devices. AvaSure has
an open API platform that enables secure, controlled integration between AvaSure in-room devices and
approved third-party applications. AvaSure has [enterprise-grade integrations and strategic
partnerships][142] to bring virtual care into every setting. 

### What AI capabilities are available in virtual care platforms today?+

[AvaSure’s platform includes AI fo][143]r fall and elopement detection, aggression detection, staff
duress wake words, and agentic AI workflows. 

### +

### What kind of ongoing support do virtual care vendors provide?+

** **AvaSure offers 24/7/365 US-based Customer Care [reachable by phone or email,][144] plus a
dedicated Customer Success Manager for every client. The CSM delivers strategic guidance, workflow
optimization, and data-driven best practices throughout the entire partnership and not just
at implementation. 

### +

### What is a smart room?+

The term “smart room” does not have a single industry definition. HIMSS, AHA, Gartner, and KLAS each
describe it differently, and every health system arrives at its own version based on its clinical
priorities, technology maturity, and operational context. What the market has converged on, however,
is a shared understanding of what a smart room is not: a collection of independent applications
running in parallel without a common infrastructure connecting them. Any individual technology in a

## Common Questions

### How much experience does AvaSure have in virtual care?+

AvaSure was founded in 2008 and has 18+ years in the virtual care business with 5,000+ deployments
across 1,200+ hospitals, millions of hours of patient monitoring, [150+ case studies,][141] and 21+
peer-reviewed journal articles.

### Does virtual care replace bedside nurses?+

No. Virtual care is designed to support bedside nurses, not replace them. AvaSure’s platform is
purpose-built to blend virtual and in-person touchpoints across a broad range of care settings,
improving both the patient and clinician experience by reducing administrative tasks, lowering
stress, and optimizing care workflows so clinicians can focus on patient outcomes.

### What types of hospitals use virtual care technology?+

Academic medical centers, community hospitals, rural/critical access hospitals, pediatric
facilities, VA facilities, and large multi-state health systems use virtual care technology to
improve staff retention, patient outcomes, and resource utilization, and reduce stress, 1:1 sitter
costs, and workplace violence.

### What clinical use cases does virtual care support?+

Virtual care supports a wide range of clinical use cases like falls prevention, elopement, workplace
violence, virtual nursing, suicide risk, pediatric monitoring, specialty consults,
admission/discharge, and more.

### What hospital care settings can use virtual care?+

Virtual care can be used across a variety of care settings, including patient rooms, critical care
units, pediatrics, emergency departments, behavioral health, operating rooms, and more.

### Can virtual care technology integrate with EHR and nurse call systems?+

Yes. AvaSure integrates with a broad ecosystem of healthcare technology, including EHR systems,
medical devices, vICU platforms, nurse call solutions, middleware, and mobile devices. AvaSure has
an open API platform that enables secure, controlled integration between AvaSure in-room devices and
approved third-party applications. AvaSure has [enterprise-grade integrations and strategic
partnerships][142] to bring virtual care into every setting. 

### What AI capabilities are available in virtual care platforms today?+

[AvaSure’s platform includes AI fo][143]r fall and elopement detection, aggression detection, staff
duress wake words, and agentic AI workflows.

** **AvaSure offers 24/7/365 US-based Customer Care [reachable by phone or email,][144] plus a
dedicated Customer Success Manager for every client. The CSM delivers strategic guidance, workflow
optimization, and data-driven best practices throughout the entire partnership and not just
at implementation.

About Comen
Shenzhen Comen Medical Instruments Co., Ltd., founded in 2002, is a global medical technology
company and leading medical equipment manufacturer specializing in high-end medical devices. With a
mission to “Share with the World,” Comen operates as a comprehensive medical device company,
delivering advanced solutions in life support, in vitro diagnostics, and medical imaging across 190+
countries. Backed by robust R&D, over 2,000 patents, and partnerships with top-tier hospitals, Comen
continues to strengthen its position among professional medical device manufacturing companies,
providing innovative, user-centered healthcare technologies. Recognized for excellence with numerous
national awards, Comen has built a respected medical equipment brand and continues to empower
medical professionals worldwide with reliable, high-quality products and services.

About Comen
Shenzhen Comen Medical Instruments Co., Ltd., founded in 2002, is a global medical technology
company and leading medical equipment manufacturer specializing in high-end medical devices. With a
mission to “Share with the World,” Comen operates as a comprehensive medical device company,
delivering advanced solutions in life support, in vitro diagnostics, and medical imaging across 190+
countries. Backed by robust R&D, over 2,000 patents, and partnerships with top-tier hospitals, Comen
continues to strengthen its position among professional medical device manufacturing companies,
providing innovative, user-centered healthcare technologies. Recognized for excellence with numerous
national awards, Comen has built a respected medical equipment brand and continues to empower
medical professionals worldwide with reliable, high-quality products and services.

# Your partner in advancing care delivery

Philips Capsule is now part of the Philips Acute Care Informatics portfolio of solutions – a
comprehensive, clinically focused ecosystem designed to enhance care delivery across the healthcare
enterprise, with a goal of improving patient outcomes and reducing clinician burnout.

[Learn more][84]

# Vendor neutral,
# open ecosystem

We are leaders in connectivity and interoperability, committed to meeting the needs of hospitals and
health systems and empowering their existing infrastructure.

[Learn more][85]

# Broad portfolio and capabilities

Meeting healthcare provider organizations where they are with flexibility and scalability across
multiple solutions to reduce vendor complexity.

[Learn more][86]

# Deep clinical and operational experience

Our support goes beyond the technology to make sure that it fits with your workflow to enable
clinical staff, not burden them.

[Learn more][87]

Our vendor-neutral approach allows healthcare organizations to utilize their current infrastructure
and progressively expand, ensuring a tailored approach for every stage of the transformation
journey.

## Our solutions

Our portfolio of informatics solutions—medical device integration, system integration engine, cloud
data storage and analytics, clinical surveillance, intensive care and perioperative patient data
management, and virtual care—provides not just individual products, but a suite of applications that
seamlessly integrate with each other and your existing hospital systems.

Why CareSimple

## Most RPM vendors make you trade control for support. CareSimple is built so you never have to.

One accountable vendor for devices, connectivity, logistics, software, billing, and the clinical
team to run it — with a fully controlled, end-to-end data path from the patient's home to your EHR.
Take on as much or as little of the day-to-day as you want; clinical control always stays with you.

[How CareSimple compares to other remote patient monitoring companies →][27]

No outsourced cellular. No outsourced software. No third-party EHR integration.
How it works

## Everything an RPM program needs — however you run it

Three jobs, one platform. Your clinicians lead the program; CareSimple keeps the infrastructure
running underneath them.

Deploy devices Monitor patients Integrate & bill
Devices & logistics

### Cellular devices, ready on arrival

Co-engineered cellular medical devices ship straight to the patient's door — pre-activated, tracked,
and transmitting from the first reading. No WiFi, no Bluetooth pairing, no app to install.
* **SLA-backed connectivity** across AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile — vitals transmit automatically
  after every reading.
* **Amazon-powered fulfillment** at enterprise scale, with real-time shipment tracking across your
  enrolled population.
* **BP, glucose, weight, and SpO2** — one device portfolio, one logistics pipeline.

[Explore the device portfolio →][28]
[CareSimple cellular blood pressure monitor] Pre-activated Shipped · arrives Thu Cellular · no WiFi
needed
Clinical workflow

### Your clinicians lead. The platform keeps up.

Condition-specific care plans, calibrated alert thresholds, and an alert triage queue — staffed by
your team, ours, or any split in between.
* **TriCheck averaging** — automates three sequential measurements and averages per clinical
  guidelines, eliminating single-reading variability.
* **Condition-specific protocols** for hypertension, diabetes, heart failure, maternity, COPD, and
  CKD.
* **Flexible staffing** — keep triage in-house, delegate after-hours coverage, or hand us day-to-day
  operations.

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

intra and postoperative outcomes.

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a

## Corsano CardioWatch

Cardiowatch is a wireless remote monitoring system intended for continuous collection of
physiological data in healthcare and home settings. Cardiowatch is a CE medical device certified
under EU-MDR standards and FDA 510(k) Cleared. This includes Pulse Rate, Heart Rate Variability (R-R
intervals), ECG, SpO2, Respiration, Blood Pressure, Core Body Temperature, Activity and Sleep. Data
is transmitted wirelessly from the bracelet via the application or gateway to a health cloud where
it is stored and made available for further analysis.

Corsano Cardiowatch can include the ability to notify healthcare professionals when physiological
data fall outside selected parameters.

# Integration

## Clinical Trials

Corsano is enabling clinical trials, in-hospital and remote patient care across the entire care
continuum with our clinically validated and EU-MDR and FDA certified CardioWatch 287 System.

Corsano is currently involved in over 100 clinical trials – **Cardiovascular, Oncology and Stress**.
Corsano’s medically certified wearables increase credibility of studies and prepare for medical
digital therapies. Corsano’s involvement in important clinical trial research consortia accelerates
the pace of medical research, enabling the discovery of new biomarkers and their clinical
validation. 

## Real-time Remote Patient Monitoring

Corsano CardioWatch 287 can monitor up to 19 Vital Parameters in real-time while post-discharge
programs often rely solely on episodic vitals (spot measurements). Healthcare providers can
develop **personalized treatment plans** that address the unique needs of each patient. Corsano can
provide patients with real-time feedback on their progress, which can help motivate them to adhere
to their treatment plan. Remote care-at-home programs deliver improved clinical outcomes, lower
costs and better patient experience: **38% ****reduction in cost of care****; ****70% ****reduction
in readmissions**; **50%**** improvement in patient mobility**

## In-Hospital Monitoring

This is the solution where data from CardioWatch is directly streamed to the gateway (no need for
phone app) and transferred to the hospital IT system, enabling central monitoring of patients and
improved quality of work for nurses. By providing nurses with real-time information about their
patients’ conditions, central monitoring can help ensure that patients receive appropriate care,
treatment, and medication at the right time, leading to better overall outcomes.

Corsano offers an API (Application Programming Interface) and SDK (Software Development Kit) to
providers of remote patient monitoring platforms and researchers, which allows them to connect
Corsano CardioWatch to their platform. The API and SDK enable to access the data collected by
Corsano CardioWatch, including synching of raw PPG, ECG, ACC and BIOZ data.

relationships. To be successful in business and life, a relationship has to be a two way street with
give and take. At Corsano, we believe in cultivating good working relationships with our partners.

SDKs. We provide access to raw and processed data to partners enabling them to offer a variety of

companies worldwide.

The Empatica Health Monitoring Platform is applicable and scalable to countless therapeutic areas.

[Discover the platform][64]

## Introducing a new era in Parkinson’s monitoring

Empatica’s Parkinson’s Monitoring combines PKG’s trusted, clinically validated motor assessments
with Empatica’s FDA-cleared and CE MDR certified wearable technology. The result: a modern,
patient-friendly way to continuously track motor symptoms and therapy response, supporting more
informed and personalized treatment decisions.

[Learn more][65]

#### 8

##### FDA clearances

We have a track-record in producing the highest quality of medical devices

#### 160+

##### countries available

Our products are currently available in over 40 languages and can be shipped globally. Local
regulations may apply

#### 100,000+

##### devices deployed

From patients to trial participants, Empatica's products have touched thousands of lives

#### 300+

##### digital measures

The largest range of digital measures in a single solution. Already being used in hundreds of
studies

#### 12,000+

##### research papers

Empatica's technology has been referenced or used to publish thousands of academic papers

## Redefining clinical research through medical wearables and digital biomarkers


Our FDA-cleared health monitoring tools are designed to seamlessly collect and monitor health data
from daily life. Empatica provides the world’s largest selection of digital measures from a single,
versatile wearable, taking gold-standard health measurements from the clinic to the comfort of
people’s homes.

More than half of the top 20 pharmaceutical companies use the Empatica Health Monitoring Platform to
monitor the impact of treatments and to develop novel digital biomarkers that can be used as digital
endpoints. Talk to our team to see how your research can benefit.

Pioneering digital biomarker development for over a decade, including the first FDA-cleared digital

clinically-validated and research-grade digital biomarkers in the world.

[See the range][63]

## An end-to-end remote monitoring solution for clinical trials

The Empatica Health Monitoring Platform is applicable and scalable to countless therapeutic areas.
Collect and monitor raw data and digital biomarkers across all phases of your trials using
FDA-cleared, award-winning medical technology, alongside a powerful and intuitive software suite.

[Discover the platform][64]

## Introducing a new era in Parkinson’s monitoring

Empatica’s Parkinson’s Monitoring combines PKG’s trusted, clinically validated motor assessments
with Empatica’s FDA-cleared and CE MDR certified wearable technology. The result: a modern,
patient-friendly way to continuously track motor symptoms and therapy response, supporting more
informed and personalized treatment decisions.

Our FDA-cleared health monitoring tools are designed to seamlessly collect and monitor health data
from daily life. Empatica provides the world’s largest selection of digital measures from a single,
versatile wearable, taking gold-standard health measurements from the clinic to the comfort of
people’s homes.

More than half of the top 20 pharmaceutical companies use the Empatica Health Monitoring Platform to

endpoints. Talk to our team to see how your research can benefit.

# Innovating Drug Delivery, Together

## ExtruPharm works with pharma and biotech innovators to design and manufacture advanced
## polymer-based drug delivery systems — from early concepts to clinical-ready prototypes and
## beyond.

[ Work With Us ][9]

## ExtruPharm Provides a Variety of Design and manufacturing Services

Our team brings together expertise in extrusion, injection molding, and custom polymer processing to
design, develop, and refine advanced drug delivery devices. Every project is approached with
precision and innovation to ensure that each device meets the most rigorous performance, quality
standards, and the demanding specifications of each client.

[[Research and development images of various drug delivery devices]][10]

### [Research and Development][11]

[[manufacturing]][12]

### [Manufacturing Services][13]

From Prototypes to Scalable Processes

[[Analytical Services tech holding vials for analyzing]][14]

### [Analytical Services][15]

Turning Data Into Decisions

[ View all services ][16]

## Products & Applications

### Shaping the Future of Combination Devices

Our expertise extends across a wide range of device formats and materials. Whether your program
requires durability, bioresorbability, or unique geometries, ExtruPharm is positioned to deliver.

### Applications Include:
* Drug-eluting implants for sustained and long-acting release
* Parenteral and implantable devices for direct-to-target or systemic delivery
* Custom geometries including rods, tubes, films, co-extruded structures, and complex profiles
* Next-generation combination devices built with polymer science and process innovation at the core

### Materials We Work With:
* Bio-durable polymers such as EVA and TPU
* Bioresorbable polymers including PLA, PLGA, PCL, and more
* Customized material blends and advanced formulations

## Why Choose ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is built around flexibility, technical depth, and cost-effectiveness. We are an ideal

# Welcome to Huntleigh

A proud member of the Arjo family Huntleigh is a leading global provider of innovative and high
quality medical equipment for healthcare professionals. 

[ View Our Products ][83]

## Who Are Huntleigh?

[ Learn More About us ][84]

### 1979

Huntleigh was founded

### 200+

Global employees

### 100+

Countries we sell to

### 40+

Years experience

## Our Product Ranges

Huntleigh is a leading global provider of innovative and high quality medical equipment for
healthcare professionals. The Diagnostic Products Division can proudly boast world leading brands
such as Dopplex, Hydroven, Sonicaid and Smartsigns, covering healthcare requirements in Vascular
Assessment & Treatment, and Obstetrics & Patient Monitoring.

[ Explore All Products ][85]

## Fetal Monitoring

Huntleigh and the Sonicaid brand have been at the forefront of maternity product innovation for over
40 years, developing a world leading range of fetal Dopplers and Monitors.

[ Explore Product Category ][86]

## Patient Monitoring

The Smartsigns Patient Monitoring range is capable of delivering a wide range of monitoring options,
ranging from hand held or portable devices which can be used to monitor the patient’s basic vital
signs, through to advanced modular systems used in many low, medium & high acuity settings
throughout all areas of healthcare.

[ Explore Product Category ][87]

## Vascular Assessment

Based on over 40 years’ experience in the field of vascular assessment, the latest generation of the
world renowned Dopplex handheld Dopplers offer even greater performance, quality and reliability.

[ Explore Product Category ][88]

# Welcome to Huntleigh

A proud member of the Arjo family Huntleigh is a leading global provider of innovative and high
quality medical equipment for healthcare professionals. 

[ View Our Products ][83]

## Who Are Huntleigh?

[ Learn More About us ][84]

### 1979

Huntleigh was founded

### 200+

Global employees

### 100+

Countries we sell to

### 40+

Years experience

## Our Product Ranges

Huntleigh is a leading global provider of innovative and high quality medical equipment for
healthcare professionals. The Diagnostic Products Division can proudly boast world leading brands
such as Dopplex, Hydroven, Sonicaid and Smartsigns, covering healthcare requirements in Vascular
Assessment & Treatment, and Obstetrics & Patient Monitoring.

[ Explore All Products ][85]

## Fetal Monitoring

Huntleigh and the Sonicaid brand have been at the forefront of maternity product innovation for over
40 years, developing a world leading range of fetal Dopplers and Monitors.

[ Explore Product Category ][86]

## Patient Monitoring

The Smartsigns Patient Monitoring range is capable of delivering a wide range of monitoring options,
ranging from hand held or portable devices which can be used to monitor the patient’s basic vital
signs, through to advanced modular systems used in many low, medium & high acuity settings
throughout all areas of healthcare.

[ Explore Product Category ][87]

## Vascular Assessment

Based on over 40 years’ experience in the field of vascular assessment, the latest generation of the
world renowned Dopplex handheld Dopplers offer even greater performance, quality and reliability.

# Welcome to Huntleigh

A proud member of the Arjo family Huntleigh is a leading global provider of innovative and high
quality medical equipment for healthcare professionals. 

[ View Our Products ][83]

## Who Are Huntleigh?

[ Learn More About us ][84]

## Our Product Ranges

Huntleigh is a leading global provider of innovative and high quality medical equipment for
healthcare professionals. The Diagnostic Products Division can proudly boast world leading brands
such as Dopplex, Hydroven, Sonicaid and Smartsigns, covering healthcare requirements in Vascular
Assessment & Treatment, and Obstetrics & Patient Monitoring.

[ Explore All Products ][85]

## Fetal Monitoring

Huntleigh and the Sonicaid brand have been at the forefront of maternity product innovation for over
40 years, developing a world leading range of fetal Dopplers and Monitors.

[ Explore Product Category ][86]

## Patient Monitoring

The Smartsigns Patient Monitoring range is capable of delivering a wide range of monitoring options,
ranging from hand held or portable devices which can be used to monitor the patient’s basic vital
signs, through to advanced modular systems used in many low, medium & high acuity settings
throughout all areas of healthcare.

[ Explore Product Category ][87]

## Vascular Assessment

Based on over 40 years’ experience in the field of vascular assessment, the latest generation of the
world renowned Dopplex handheld Dopplers offer even greater performance, quality and reliability.

[ Explore Product Category ][88]

## Vascular Treatment

Combining the Hydroven IPC range with the Dopplex Vascular Assessment products provides each of its
customers with a comprehensive unmatched portfolio targeting the assessment and treatment of
vascular conditions.

[ Explore Product Category ][89]

## Search by Interest

Explore our products based on the needs of your clinical practice.

## Not Sure Which Product You Need?

Whether it’s the safe delivery of a new life, improving the day-to-day quality of life or monitoring
life’s vital signs, we aim for clinical excellence and improved performance, for life.

## Our Supporting Services

Huntleigh offers comprehensive product service and support contracts which are designed to protect
your investment.

#### UK Service Support

Huntleigh Healthcare is pleased to be able to offer our service as an experienced and established
repair facility for our Diagnostic Products Division’s equipment.
 
Huntleigh have experienced staff that have been repairing Huntleigh and Sonicaid™ equipment for many
years, providing support for hospitals and support organisations.

[ Explore UK Support ][102]

#### International Service Support

Working in partnership, we aim to provide you with support wherever and whenever it’s needed.

For support in the first instance please contact your local distributor or agent, we are represented
in many parts of the world with trained and experienced partners so provide a high level of quality
support.

[ Explore International Support ][103]

## Helping Support Your Learning

Through the Academy, we ensure that the Huntleigh people you depend on for support always have
updated knowledge and skillsets to help you in the daily use of our equipment. So that you and
people you care for get the most from our products, and every day can be a good day.

[ Explore Our Academy Resources ][104]

### About Us

Huntleigh is a leading global provider of innovative and high quality medical equipment for
healthcare professionals.

[ Learn More About Us ][105]

### Careers

If you want to be a part of an organisation that not only cares about performance, but about its
staff’s wellbeing and development, Huntleigh is the ideal company to join.

[ Learn More About Careers ][106]

### eIFUs & IFUs

View our most recent instructions for use documents.

[ Explore All eIFUs & IFUs ][107]

### Quality & Regulatory Compliance

A number of authorities contribute to ensure that medical devices are safe and well-functioning. It
is important that Huntleigh complies with the rules that apply in the markets where our products are
sold. 

[ Learn More About Compliance ][108]

## Not sure where to look?

Huntleigh’s product range gives you a variety of ways to address your clinical challenges, but
sometimes it can be tricky to know what solution is best. If you’re not sure, our team is always
available to answer any queries and make sure you get the perfect solution for you.

[ Sample Page ][134] [ Contact our team now ][135]
[ [Huntleigh a member of the Arjo family] ][136]

As a proud member of the Arjo family, we believe that great healthcare is always a collective
effort. The greatest contribution we can provide to patients, and the professionals who care for
them, is confidence. This is what we have been striving for since 1979, with innovative solutions in
vascular care, fetal and patient monitoring. Solutions that can assist clinicians in improving
outcomes and enhancing patient wellbeing. Whether it’s the safe delivery of a new life, improving
the day-to-day quality of life or monitoring life’s vital signs, we aim for clinical excellence and
improved performance, for life.

vitals monitoring devices and consumer healthcare products help people of all ages take a more
active role in managing their health. 

Recently, iHealth played a critical role during the Covid-19 pandemic as a major supplier of at-home
tests to the American federal government. In this urgent time, iHealth quickly stepped up to meet an
important public health demand.

We see a world of untethered healthcare driven by wireless Biosensors and patient monitoring

enables enhanced patient care and data-driven clinical insights by untethering patients from wired

LifeSync, an Amphenol company, is a global, vertically integrated designer and manufacturer focused

variation, streamline procurement and inventory management, and improve staff familiarity.

monitoring as patients move across care settings. By reducing the need to reposition leads,
clinicians save time and avoid unnecessary procedural disruption.

## Standardization Across the Full Patient Stay

### 1 Patient, 1 Leadwire, 1 Placement

LifeSync helps healthcare organizations standardize cardiac monitoring with a single leadwire that
stays with the patient throughout the full stay—without adapters, workarounds, or unnecessary
complexity. By consolidating vendors and SKUs into a more manageable system, hospitals reduce
variation, streamline procurement and inventory management, and improve staff familiarity.

[ Simplify Leadwire Management  ][110]
[Image]

## Radiolucent ECG Leadwires

### Clarity without compromise

LifeSync radiolucent leadwires are engineered to minimize interference during fluoroscopy and other
imaging procedures, resulting in clearer imaging, improved workflow efficiency, and uninterrupted
monitoring as patients move across care settings. By reducing the need to reposition leads,
clinicians save time and avoid unnecessary procedural disruption. 

[ See the Difference ][111]
[Image]

## Close-loop ECG Leadwire Reprocessing

### A responsible approach to lifecycle management

ReLife, by LifeSync, is an inventory-guaranteed reprocessed ECG leadwire designed to help hospitals
reduce medical waste, control costs, and maintain clinical quality through a standardized,
closed-loop model. ReLife gives you a disciplined lifecycle approach that supports environmental and
financial goals—without variability or compromise.

[ Learn About Reprocessing  ][112]
[Image]

## Manufacturing Automation 

### Engineered for precision and scale 

LifeSync is the industry-proven leader in automated SpO₂ and ECG manufacturing. Our global,
ISO-certified operations leverage modular, scalable automation for consistent quality and cost
efficiency across any production volume. Automated assembly, testing, and validation delivers a
stable 99% First Pass Yield (FPY) from pilot to production.

institutions with world-class equipment and technology to enhance patient care and improve lives."

companies to report some of their carbon emissions (Scope 1 and 2, but not Scope 3). While some feel

respective carbon footprints and develop solutions to reduce our environmental impact. Many major
biopharmaceutical companies have science-based, net-zero targets set for no later than 2050. As this

brain ablation. [Image courtesy of Monteris Medical]Monteris Medical today said its launch of the
NeuroBlate NB3 FullFire makes it the smallest laser probe for brain procedures on the market.

in a single adjustable length.

system’s devices and accessories in December 2023 and started a limited market release in February.

[Adobe Stock]

“augmented intelligence” to “artificial intelligence.” His company uses AI tools to support human
experts in drug repurposing efforts.

to AI from wearable digital health devices. “I quickly found out that it’s very important to be able

Chicago-based company designed the technology to create a more personalized and seamless oncology
care pathway experience for clinicians and patients. The technology was showcased at the European
Society for Therapeutic Radiology and Oncology 2024 Congress in Glasgow, Scotland.

The company also launched an updated and artificial intelligence (AI)-enhanced version of the

Center’s Department of Orthopaedic Surgery.

McCombs offered advice for building a medtech career inside a big company.

### **Medical Equipment Leasing, Rentals & Sales**

##### Welcome to Med One Group, your nationwide medical equipment supplier. Our custom leasing,
##### rental and sales solutions offer you various ways to secure the medical equipment you need,
##### exactly when you need it.

[ [MEDICAL EQUIPMENT LEASING] ][227] [ **MEDICAL EQUIPMENT LEASING** ][228]
.
**QUICKVIEW**
**MEDICAL EQUIPMENT LEASING**
.
We specialize in creative leasing solutions such as:
* Capital Leases
* Operating Leases
* Equity Rental
* Deferred Payments
* Step-Up Payments
* Custom Leasing Options
Whether you need equipment for a few months or a few years, we will offer you exceptional and
creative terms. As one of the country's top medical equipment leasing companies, we're ready to
start improving your operations today.
[**LEARN MORE**][229]

**X**

[ [MEDICAL EQUIPMENT RENTALS] ][230] [ **MEDICAL EQUIPMENT RENTALS** ][231]
.
**QUICKVIEW**
**MEDICAL EQUIPMENT RENTALS**
.
We also offer short-term solutions in the form of rental equipment. As trusted hospital equipment
suppliers, we work with the best and most well-known equipment manufacturers. Our equipment rental
ranges from modular systems, infusion pumps, ventilators, therapy equipment, beds and more. All
equipment is shipped patient-ready. Med One has distribution offices in California, Utah, North
Carolina, Georgia, Colorado, Arizona and Florida.
[**LEARN MORE**][232]

**X**

.
**QUICKVIEW**
**MEDICAL EQUIPMENT SALES**
.
As your medical equipment supplier, we also offer tools for purchase. Whether you need a single
infusion pump or you want to outfit entire departments, Med One has options to serve your needs. Our
equipment has proven itself time and time again — every item in our inventory has been carefully
chosen and evaluated before being refurbished by our in-house Biomed team. Search our leading
equipment options from BD, Baxter, Medtronic, GE, Hamilton and others today.
[**LEARN MORE**][235]

**X**

.
**QUICKVIEW**
**BIOMEDICAL SERVICES**
.
Our biomedical facility is committed to making sure that each piece of equipment we rent or sell is

# Clinical systems engineered for measured decisions from ICU to home care.

Mindray aligns bedside monitors, anesthesia workstations, portable ultrasound workflows, and
discharge-ready DME programs with traceable performance data, service accountability, and
interoperability documentation.

[Review Performance Data][8] [Speak to a Clinical Specialist][9]
Deployment readiness

## Technical documentation grouped for value analysis committees.

Each program package is organized around clinical accuracy, lifecycle support, cybersecurity, and
reimbursement context so biomed, nursing, IT, and procurement teams can work from the same evidence
set.

### Patient monitoring performance

SpO2 accuracy tables, ECG waveform export, alarm priority mapping under IEC 60601-1-8, HL7
observation push frequency, and post-market surveillance summaries are supplied for committee
review.

### Respiratory and anesthesia continuity

Ventilator-monitor connectivity, anesthesia workstation service intervals, vaporizers and gas module
verification, transport battery expectations, and alarm fatigue mitigation are documented before
evaluation.

### Hospital-to-home handoff

Home health bundles include caregiver training, FHIR-ready observations, Bluetooth pairing guides,
cellular fallback options, and HCPCS context for DME coordination.
[ICU monitoring station]
Closed-loop monitoring

## Waveforms, alarms, and observations are built for clinical governance.

Mindray monitoring workflows document priority alarms, waveform fidelity, NIBP protocols, SpO2
tolerances, and event export controls. The result is a cleaner handoff between bedside teams, biomed
service, informatics, and post-market quality reporting.

[Anesthesia workstation in operating room]
Respiratory continuity

## OR, ICU, and transport teams share the same service vocabulary.

Respiratory and anesthesia programs include preventive maintenance plans, gas module verification,
battery runtime documentation, spare-part depot coverage, and escalation routing so uptime claims
can be reviewed against operational controls.

[Home monitoring kit]
Discharge-ready care

## Home care programs keep clinical evidence attached to the device.

Caregiver guides, training checklists, device pairing steps, and remote observation workflows make
discharge planning easier for case managers while preserving traceability for clinical operations
and supply teams.

**ISO 13485**QMS aligned documentation
**FHIR R4**Integration planning support
**24/7**Service escalation routing
**510(k)**Regulatory file support
**UDI**Device identity controls
Care settings

## Configured for sites that need clinical depth without procurement ambiguity.

ICU

### Hospitals

Multi-parameter monitoring, ventilator interfaces, central telemetry, and biomedical service
coverage.

OR

### Surgical Centers

Anesthesia workstations, perioperative monitoring, alarm review, and device training for rotating
teams.

RPM

### Remote Care

Home observation kits, FHIR-ready data pathways, caregiver training, and adherence reporting.

DME

### Home Health

Discharge bundles, DME documentation, patient support routing, and supply continuity planning.

Procurement confidence

## What clinical and biomedical teams ask us to prove.

"Mindray's technical file format made our alarm governance review more concrete. We could compare
priorities, export behavior, and service coverage before device trials."

**Director of Clinical Engineering**Academic hospital network

"The respiratory care packet joined OR, ICU, and transport workflows in one review. That reduced
duplicate questions from anesthesia, nursing, and biomed."

**Perioperative Technology Lead**Regional surgical program

"For home monitoring, the caregiver training and data path documentation gave our discharge team a
practical starting point for remote follow-up."

**Population Health Manager**Home care program

## Build a documented evaluation pack for your care setting.

Request IFU files, interoperability notes, service coverage, and performance tables for patient
monitoring, respiratory care, or home health deployment.

[Request Evaluation Pack][10]

#### Subscribe to Clinical Bulletins

Monthly digest: 510(k) clearances, IFU revisions, cybersecurity advisories, service notices, and
clinical workflow summaries.

## About Us

Advanced medical equipment plays a crucial role in enhancing the quality of life and fulfilling
people's unwavering pursuit of good health. With the belief that "the world is flat" and "a healthy
world is accessible," the founders of Minttihealth have joined hands with the aim of leveraging
modern technologies to create a better and healthier world.

Minttihealth takes pride in its exceptional team, which mainly consists of scientists from the
Chinese Academy of Sciences, who are leaders in their respective fields such as sensors, acoustic

# Introducing the Nonin Health^{®} Platform

### Cloud-Based, Remote Access to Pulse Oximetry

Home-based oxygen qualification and overnight oximetry testing have long been constrained by
burdensome workflows, delayed access to data, and limited provider reimbursement. Nonin Medical’s
introduction of the Nonin Health® platform simplifies the process, reduces administrative and
logistical burden, and enables remote access to testing results so health care providers can deliver
more timely and cost-effective therapy.

[Learn More About the Platform][86] [Visit the Product Page][87]

# Introducing FDA-cleared performance

### at your fingertips

We are excited to introduce our FDA-cleared pulse oximeter: TruO2® OTC. It’s a medical-grade
fingertip oximeter that performs across all skin tones. TruO2® OTC provides equitable, accurate
blood oxygen and pulse readings for people with varying skin pigmentations, and it’s available over
the counter—no prescription required.

[TruO2 OTC Product Page][88] [Buy Now][89]

# Celebrating 40 Years of Innovation

### In Noninvasive Patient Monitoring

Since 1986, Nonin has been a trusted name in noninvasive patient monitoring, driven by our
commitment to accuracy, durability, and delivering actionable data to clinicians and patients
worldwide. Join us as we reflect on four decades of pioneering innovation and look forward to the
next chapter of innovation.

[READ ABOUT OUR LEGACY][90] [Watch and celebrate 40 years][91]

Our innovative, **nonin**vasive monitoring solutions work wherever and whenever you need them—even
in challenging conditions—so you can concentrate on delivering the highest quality patient care.

## You work hard.

Your top priority is your patient—not troubleshooting medical devices. Our patient monitoring
solutions are easy to use and provide consistent measurements time after time. Nonin pulse and
regional oximeters, capnographs, and sensors deliver accurate data to help you focus on care.

### A history of **dependable solutions**

We work constantly to improve our technologies and create monitoring solutions that deliver
consistent performance in the most challenging conditions. We are committed to providing the
critical information you need to make decisions, take action, and keep moving.

## Featured **Products**

### Nonin Health^{®} Platform

Nonin Health^{®} is a secure, cloud-based platform that provides remote access to pulse oximetry
data creating workflow efficiencies for your overnight oximetry tests. It seamlessly integrates with
the WristOx2^{®} Model 3150BLE, giving healthcare providers streamlined and secure access to patient
data for more informed decision-making. Designed for clinical efficiency from collection to
analysis, the Nonin Health platform simplifies pulse oximetry workflows and helps support better
patient management.¹

#### Cloud-Based **Data Management**

Streamline workflows with secure, cloud-based access that eliminates manual transfers and reduces
administrative time.

#### **Patient-Centered** Accuracy

Accurate SpO2 and pulse rate readings help support confident clinical decisions.

[Learn More][98] [View All Products][99]
[featured-img]

### Model 7500

The Nonin Model 7500 Pulse Oximeter empowers caregivers with reliable, accurate oximetry
information^{2,3} — helping them act quickly and confidently in the moments that matter.

Lightweight, compact, and portable, the 7500 is ideal for monitoring infant, pediatric, and adult
patients in a variety of clinical and homecare settings and durable enough for heavy and repeated
use.

#### Easy to Use

A variety of indicators ensure reliable reading: a color-coded pulse strength bar graph, pulse
quality indicator, and sensor fault indicator

#### Long **Battery Life**

Operates on AC line voltage or an internal battery that provides 16 hour runtime with a 4 hour quick
recharge

[Learn More][100] [View All Products][101]
[featured-img]

### Onyx^{®} Vantage 9590

The Onyx Vantage 9590 is a small, lightweight, portable device indicated for use in measuring and
displaying functional oxygen saturation of arterial hemoglobin (%SpO2) and pulse rate of patients
who are well or poorly perfused. Suitable for use in hospitals, clinics, long-term care facilities,
skilled nursing facilities, emergency medical services, and home healthcare services.

#### **Portable **Design

Weighs less than two ounces and can be taken anywhere

#### **Reliable**
#### Measurements

Provides up to 6,000 spot checks on two AAA batteries and includes a 4-year warranty

This clinically proven technology provides precise oximetry measurements even in the presence of
motion, low perfusion, or other challenging conditions. PureSAT automatically adjusts to each
patient's condition to provide fast and reliable readings.

# Introducing the Nonin Health^{®} Platform

### Cloud-Based, Remote Access to Pulse Oximetry

Home-based oxygen qualification and overnight oximetry testing have long been constrained by
burdensome workflows, delayed access to data, and limited provider reimbursement. Nonin Medical’s
introduction of the Nonin Health® platform simplifies the process, reduces administrative and
logistical burden, and enables remote access to testing results so health care providers can deliver
more timely and cost-effective therapy.

[Learn More About the Platform][86] [Visit the Product Page][87]

# Introducing FDA-cleared performance

### at your fingertips

We are excited to introduce our FDA-cleared pulse oximeter: TruO2® OTC. It’s a medical-grade
fingertip oximeter that performs across all skin tones. TruO2® OTC provides equitable, accurate
blood oxygen and pulse readings for people with varying skin pigmentations, and it’s available over
the counter—no prescription required.

[TruO2 OTC Product Page][88] [Buy Now][89]

# Celebrating 40 Years of Innovation

### In Noninvasive Patient Monitoring

Since 1986, Nonin has been a trusted name in noninvasive patient monitoring, driven by our
commitment to accuracy, durability, and delivering actionable data to clinicians and patients
worldwide. Join us as we reflect on four decades of pioneering innovation and look forward to the
next chapter of innovation.

[READ ABOUT OUR LEGACY][90] [Watch and celebrate 40 years][91]
[Health & Safety][92] [Nonin Fingertip Solutions][93] [Sensor Compatibility Tool][94]

## **Count on Nonin**

in challenging conditions—so you can concentrate on delivering the highest quality patient care.

## You work hard.

solutions are easy to use and provide consistent measurements time after time. Nonin pulse and

consistent performance in the most challenging conditions. We are committed to providing the
critical information you need to make decisions, take action, and keep moving.

## Clinically proven technologies and field-tested solutions
## **designed to support the highest standards of care**

[img]

### **Emergency Medicine**

EMS professionals need equipment that stands up to frequent use, day and night. Nonin oximetry
solutions are engineered to deliver reliable measurements every time. They give EMS specialists the
data they need to take action quickly.

[Learn More][95]
[img]

### **Hospitals and Clinics**

Clinicians rely on durable pulse oximetry monitoring devices to deliver quality patient care
throughout the hospital. Nonin devices are designed to work wherever and whenever they are needed,
so clinicians can make confident decisions.

[Learn More][96]
[img]

### **Original Equipment Manufacturers**

Nonin is a leading global provider of OEM solutions in pulse and regional oximetry. Our
easy-to-integrate components and dedicated support team have helped more than 200 OEM customers
bring more than a million medical devices to market.

[Learn More][97]

## Featured **Products**

### Nonin Health^{®} Platform

Nonin Health^{®} is a secure, cloud-based platform that provides remote access to pulse oximetry
data creating workflow efficiencies for your overnight oximetry tests. It seamlessly integrates with
the WristOx2^{®} Model 3150BLE, giving healthcare providers streamlined and secure access to patient
data for more informed decision-making. Designed for clinical efficiency from collection to
analysis, the Nonin Health platform simplifies pulse oximetry workflows and helps support better
patient management.¹

#### Cloud-Based **Data Management**

Streamline workflows with secure, cloud-based access that eliminates manual transfers and reduces
administrative time.

#### **Patient-Centered** Accuracy

Accurate SpO2 and pulse rate readings help support confident clinical decisions.

[Learn More][98] [View All Products][99]
[featured-img]

### Model 7500

The Nonin Model 7500 Pulse Oximeter empowers caregivers with reliable, accurate oximetry
information^{2,3} — helping them act quickly and confidently in the moments that matter.

Lightweight, compact, and portable, the 7500 is ideal for monitoring infant, pediatric, and adult
patients in a variety of clinical and homecare settings and durable enough for heavy and repeated
use.

#### Easy to Use

A variety of indicators ensure reliable reading: a color-coded pulse strength bar graph, pulse
quality indicator, and sensor fault indicator

#### Long **Battery Life**

Operates on AC line voltage or an internal battery that provides 16 hour runtime with a 4 hour quick
recharge

[Learn More][100] [View All Products][101]
[featured-img]

### Onyx^{®} Vantage 9590

The Onyx Vantage 9590 is a small, lightweight, portable device indicated for use in measuring and
displaying functional oxygen saturation of arterial hemoglobin (%SpO2) and pulse rate of patients
who are well or poorly perfused. Suitable for use in hospitals, clinics, long-term care facilities,
skilled nursing facilities, emergency medical services, and home healthcare services.

#### **Portable **Design

Weighs less than two ounces and can be taken anywhere

#### **Reliable**
#### Measurements

Provides up to 6,000 spot checks on two AAA batteries and includes a 4-year warranty

patient's condition to provide fast and reliable readings.

paragraph you type into the converter above comes back sounding like someone speaking, not a machine
spelling words out.

## How to convert text to speech online

Three steps, all on this page. Type or paste your text into the box, pick a voice — choose your
language first if you don't need English — and press Generate. The audio plays right away, and the
MP3 download is free. No account, no watermark, no trial clock.

## 93 free text to speech voices in 19 languages

The free converter comes with 93 voices — male and female — across English, Spanish, French, German,
Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Swedish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, and
Arabic, among others. That's enough range to narrate a video in one language and welcome your
customers in another. You can convert up to 1,000 characters at a time and 5,000 characters a day,
and the allowance resets every day — come back tomorrow and keep converting for free.

## When you need more than a good reading voice

Some projects need a voice with a personality — warm for a bedtime story, confident for a product
video, calm for a meditation track. That is what the expressive voices in the locked row are for.
They take direction the way a voice actor would, keep their character across a whole book or
podcast, and make listeners forget they're hearing a recording made from text. Press play on any of
them to hear the difference; creating with them takes a free account.

## What people make with it

The most common things we see: video and course narration finished in minutes instead of takes,
audiobooks produced chapter by chapter, articles turned into something you can listen to on a
commute, an easier way to read for anyone who prefers listening, and quick voiceover drafts that let
a team approve a script before booking studio time. If your text can be read, it can be spoken.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is this text to speech tool free?

Yes. You can convert up to 5,000 characters every day without creating an account, and the MP3
download is included. The allowance resets daily, so you can come back tomorrow and keep going free.

Type or paste your text into the box at the top of this page, pick a language and a voice, and press
Generate. The audio plays right away and you can download it as an MP3.

### Can I download the audio?

Yes — every conversion comes with a free MP3 download. There is no watermark and no trial clock.

### How much text can I convert at once?

Up to 1,000 characters per conversion and 5,000 characters per day for free. If you work with longer
texts — articles, chapters, whole books — a free account raises the limits and opens the full
studio.

### What languages does it support?

The free converter speaks 19 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian,
Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Swedish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, and Arabic —
93 voices in total, male and female.

### Can I use the audio commercially?

Audio from the free converter is for personal projects. Commercial use — monetized videos, client
work, ads, anything that makes money — requires a commercial plan, which includes full commercial
rights.

### Do the voices sound natural or robotic?

Natural. The voices read with real pauses, rhythm, and emphasis rather than word-by-word. The
expressive voices go further still — press play on any of them above and judge with your own ears.

### Do I need to install anything?

No. Everything runs in your browser, on desktop and on your phone. Type, listen, downl

Text to speech, explained

## Turn any text into natural speech

Text to speech turns written words into spoken audio. The best voices don't read one word at a time
— they sound like a person reading to you, with natural pauses, rhythm, and emphasis. That's why a
paragraph you type into the converter above comes back sounding like someone speaking, not a machine
spelling words out.

## How to convert text to speech online

Three steps, all on this page. Type or paste your text into the box, pick a voice — choose your
language first if you don't need English — and press Generate. The audio plays right away, and the
MP3 download is free. No account, no watermark, no trial clock.

## 93 free text to speech voices in 19 languages

The free converter comes with 93 voices — male and female — across English, Spanish, French, German,
Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Swedish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, and
Arabic, among others. That's enough range to narrate a video in one language and welcome your
customers in another. You can convert up to 1,000 characters at a time and 5,000 characters a day,
and the allowance resets every day — come back tomorrow and keep converting for free.

## When you need more than a good reading voice

Some projects need a voice with a personality — warm for a bedtime story, confident for a product
video, calm for a meditation track. That is what the expressive voices in the locked row are for.
They take direction the way a voice actor would, keep their character across a whole book or
podcast, and make listeners forget they're hearing a recording made from text. Press play on any of
them to hear the difference; creating with them takes a free account.

## What people make with it

The most common things we see: video and course narration finished in minutes instead of takes,
audiobooks produced chapter by chapter, articles turned into something you can listen to on a
commute, an easier way to read for anyone who prefers listening, and quick voiceover drafts that let
a team approve a script before booking studio time. If your text can be read, it can be spoken.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is this text to speech tool free?

Yes. You can convert up to 5,000 characters every day without creating an account, and the MP3
download is included. The allowance resets daily, so you can come back tomorrow and keep going free.

### How do I convert text to speech online?

Type or paste your text into the box at the top of this page, pick a language and a voice, and press
Generate. The audio plays right away and you can download it as an MP3.

### Can I download the audio?

Yes — every conversion comes with a free MP3 download. There is no watermark and no trial clock.

### How much text can I convert at once?

Up to 1,000 characters per conversion and 5,000 characters per day for free. If you work with longer
texts — articles, chapters, whole books — a free account raises the limits and opens the full
studio.

### What languages does it support?

The free converter speaks 19 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian,
Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Swedish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, and Arabic —
93 voices in total, male and female.

### Can I use the audio commercially?

Audio from the free converter is for personal projects. Commercial use — monetized videos, client
work, ads, anything that makes money — requires a commercial plan, which includes full commercial
rights.

### Do the voices sound natural or robotic?

Natural. The voices read with real pauses, rhythm, and emphasis rather than word-by-word. The
expressive voices go further still — press play on any of them above and judge with your own ears.

### Do I need to install anything?

No. Everything runs in your browser, on desktop and on your phone. Type, listen, download — that's
it.

They are our most lifelike voices — they take direction the way a voice actor would and keep their

ORDR IQ is the AI-powered orchestration layer that makes asset intelligence accessible across your
entire organization, no technical expertise required. A facilities manager can query elevator
maintenance schedules. A security analyst can pull threat reports. IT can request a list of devices
that are EoL or EoS within the next 6 months. Everyone works from the same verified data.

ORDR IQ interprets signals, correlates verified data, and aligns teams around the same trusted
understanding of risk. From that foundation, you can confidently prioritize what matters and act
together.

[See ORDR IQ in Action][10]

Try asking…

What devices are at risk right now?Show segmentation gaps in my OT networkWhich IoT devices need
policy updates?Summarize compliance posture for HIPAA

Live environment at [iq.ordr.net][11]

Why ORDR

## Why Organizations Choose ORDR

The world needed a better way to defend what's connected. Visibility alone doesn't reduce risk. ORDR
turns insights into safe, continuous enforcement across your environment.

AI Built for Security, not added to it

AI isn't a feature in ORDR, it's the foundation. Our platform is trained on real-world behavior
across millions of connected devices, understanding how they communicate, what's normal, and what's
not. The result:
* •Deeper, more accurate device intelligence
* •Fewer false positives
* •Decisions you can trust, because they're grounded in trust

Orchestration that words with you, not around you

Security doesn't need more automation. It needs the right decisions at the right time. ORDR combines
AI-driven insight with human control, so you decide how and when action happens.
* •AI investigates, explains, and recommends
* •You approve what matters
* •Every action is governed, traceable, and controlled

Human-led. AI-informed. Code-enforced.

Proactive security vs reactive defense

Most tools help you respond faster. ORDR helps you act before risk becomes an incident.
* •Identify and prioritize risk based on real behavior
* •Continuously reduce exposure, not just react to alerts
* •Enforce protection before threats spread

This isn't a faster response. It's a fundamentally different way to operate.

#### How can I get a quote from Prime?

It's very easy to [get a quote][83] from us. Simply answer a few questions, and we'll send you a
quote. You can even continue to check out and sign up online. If you'd prefer to speak to someone,
you can also call us to speak to one of our helpful team members. [Contact us here][84]

#### Can I insure my vehicle if it's currently under finance?

Yes. In fact, most financial agreements require that your car be covered by comprehensive car
insurance that protects it against damage or loss when it's under finance. Our Prime [Comprehensive
cover][85] is a great option that offers some unique and exciting benefits.

#### Does Prime offer roadside assistance?

Yes, we provide 24/7 nationwide roadside assistance to all our policyholders to ensure you’re never
left stranded next to the road. This service includes help with breakdowns, towing services, flat
tyres, and more.

#### Where can I find my Prime policy documents and forms?

page. If you download our Prime app, you'll also conveniently find them there when you're on the go.
