Precision-based patient monitoring solutions

# Smarter anesthesia.
# Safer recoveries.

Trusted by thousands of clinicians, TetraGraph delivers smart and accurate train-of-four (TOF)
monitoring to optimize intubation conditions, neuromuscular block management and reversal dosing. 

[Discover TetraGraph][11]  [Request TetraGraph demo][12]

Designed with focus on sustainability, performance and usability

## New TetraSens sensor out!

Supporting clinicians with improved visual guidance for faster, more consistent placement.

Compared with legacy sensors, the new sensor design uses 50% less dielectric material while
maintaining the same trusted performance specifications. It is manufactured in Europe using a more
environmentally friendly process, supported by a regional supply chain and shorter transportation
routes.

Data-driven clinical insights for next-generation neuromuscular monitoring

## Introducing TetraAnalytics data analytics platform

TetraAnalytics is a cloud-based data analytics platform for next-generation TetraGraph users. 

The platform transforms invisible patterns into operational insights, helping healthcare teams apply
clinical best practices, optimize workflows, and achieve better patient and economic outcomes.

# Smarter anesthesia.

routes.

specializes in ultrasound examination, electrocardiogram examination, and other medical equipment
for the healthcare sector. The company has a proven track record of providing state-of-the-art

and physical examination, general department and electrocardiogram examination, ICU, anesthesiology,
and other medical services. Our products are designed to cater to the specific needs of different
medical institutions and can be customized to meet the unique requirements of our clients.

work closely with our clients to understand their specific needs and requirements. With our
experience and expertise, we can provide tailor-made solutions that meet the individual needs of our

## Doppler Ultrasound: Know the Price and Benefits

Doppler Ultrasound Price Caters to Substantial Market GrowthThe medical imaging industry has
witnessed remarkable advancements over the past few decades, with innovative technologies proving to
be crucial in diagnosing and treating various medical conditions. Among these technologies, Doppler
ultrasound stands out as a reliable and cost-effective tool for visualizing blood flow within the
body. With its widespread application in obstetrics, cardiology, and vascular imaging, the Doppler
ultrasound market has experienced substantial growth.In recent news, the renowned company {} has
released a range of Doppler ultrasound machines that not only offer exceptional quality but also
come at competitive prices. This move aims to address the demands of an expanding market while
maintaining the company's commitment to providing cutting-edge medical equipment to healthcare
professionals worldwide.Doppler ultrasound is a non-invasive imaging technique that utilizes sound
waves to assess blood flow in real-time. By measuring the frequency shift of the sound waves
reflecting off moving blood cells, physicians can obtain valuable information about the condition of
blood vessels and the efficiency of blood circulation. This imaging modality has proven
indispensable in assessing diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, peripheral artery disease, and
even fetal well-being during pregnancy.One of the significant factors contributing to the rising
demand for Doppler ultrasound is its safety and versatility. Unlike other imaging modalities that
involve radiation exposure, Doppler ultrasound presents no known risks, making it suitable for
monitoring patients of all ages. Additionally, Doppler ultrasound machines are portable, allowing
physicians to perform real-time assessments at the bedside or in remote areas with limited access to
healthcare facilities.The release of {}'s new line of Doppler ultrasound machines aims to capitalize
on the rapidly growing medical imaging market. By offering competitive prices without compromising
on quality, the company seeks to enable healthcare providers, especially those in developing
regions, to enhance their diagnostic capabilities without incurring exorbitant costs. This move is
expected to strengthen the company's position in the global market while driving substantial growth
in the Doppler ultrasound industry.Moreover, the enhanced affordability of Doppler ultrasound
machines is expected to foster wider adoption, particularly in emerging economies. The improving
healthcare infrastructure in these regions, coupled with advancements in training and education, has
created a demand for cost-effective medical imaging technologies. By offering Doppler ultrasound
machines at a competitive price, the market becomes more accessible to healthcare professionals,
enabling them to provide better care to their patients.Another significant aspect to consider is the
increasing prevalence of cardiovascular diseases worldwide. According to the World Health
Organization, an estimated 17.9 million deaths occur annually due to cardiovascular diseases,
accounting for over 31% of all global deaths. This alarming statistic underscores the importance of
early detection and accurate diagnosis. Doppler ultrasound, with its ability to provide real-time
imaging of blood flow and detect abnormalities in the cardiovascular system, emerges as a critical
tool in combating this global health crisis.The introduction of cost-effective Doppler ultrasound
machines by {} is set to revolutionize the industry while ensuring that advanced medical imaging
remains accessible to healthcare providers across the globe. This strategic move aligns with the
company's vision of improving patient care by empowering healthcare professionals with innovative
technologies. As the market continues to evolve, it is anticipated that the affordable pricing
strategy implemented by {} will stimulate further growth, leading to improved healthcare

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## There’s never been more pressure on healthcare systems to do more, more efficiently, than right
## now.

Count on Spacelabs to help you accelerate care team performance through smarter operational
strategies, more actionable informatics, and easier integration. There’s a lot on the line—for you
and the patients you serve—and getting it right is crucial to your long-term success.

## With you all the way

Provide the experience your patients expect while managing your resources to meet today’s realities.
From strategic planning through post-installation support, count on Spacelabs to help you achieve
your care team performance goals.

together.

Our Top Picks

  [Sesame logo]

  schedule a visit in-person or virtually–whichever fits your schedule best.
  
  [Learn More][34]

  [BetterHelp logo]

  video, or live chat sessions for professional and convenient mental and behavioral health therapy.

  services through the links provided.

  Hims is here to help. In-person visits are not required – you’ll receive all the assistance and
  support you need through the Hims app.

What We Do

supported by TimeDoc receive the highest quality care that addresses their behavioral health
disorders and co-occurring chronic diseases. TimeDoc is patient-centered in their approach to
quality care management services, ensuring that provider teams have what they need to address a
patient's whole-person health.

**Amanda Brooks, LCSW, CADC**
Brooks Integrated Solution

when we recognize our team can be just as efficient with a virtual care appointment. I can’t tell
you how many times we used to treat patients for high blood pressure, when they were just anxious or
stressed from the commute to the office. Now, we have the capability to get a patient’s reading
before they leave their living room.

**David Bollard, DO**
Chief Executive Officer
Premier Health Associates

[Sabrina Ford]

away from our physical locations. The most important thing for us is delivering timely, effective
care, and our system is empowered by technology and specialized staffing that optimizes our
operation even when the circumstances are unpredictable.

**Sabrina Ford, BSN-RN
**Director of Nursing
Rainelle Medical Center

why TimeDoc Health has been a lifeline that allows us to manage a growing population of patients
across the state. In Colorado, the majority of our constituents are living in rural communities –
from Baca to Garfield County – and in mountainous regions that have limited access to care centers.
If we can increase the frequency of when and how we connect with patients, we will be able to make
more accurate decisions around their long-term care needs.

Our innovative Vitals Hub enables an Integrated Patient Monitoring & Report System (IPMRS) resulting
in a patient centric network thus bringing together Patients, Patients Care Personnel and their
Electronic Health Records(EHR) from health organizations. 

* Applicable to multiple health specialties
* Ability to use commercial off the shelf equipment, standard interfaces and health standards
* Automated vitals data entry for use by health care and emergency contact personnel
* Vitals tolerances and trigger points tailorable to individual patient for reporting
* Integrated vitals, food and meds data to get the whole picture
* Patient specific reports at required intervals to healthcare providers
* Patient specific Critical Alerts even when device is locked, when vitals are out of specified
  range
* Six Sigma based continuous Quality Improvements

## About us

Learn about Yonker

## Xuzhou Yonker Electronic Science Technology Co., Ltd.

Yonker founded in 2005 and we are a world-renowned professional medical equipment manufacture
integrating R&D, production, sales and service. Now Yonker has seven subsidiaries.The products in3
categories cover more than 20 series include oximeters, patient monitors, ECG, syringe pumps, blood
pressure monitors, oxygen concentrator, nebulizers etc., which are exported to more than 140
countries and regions.

Yonker has two R&D centers in Shenzhen and Xuzhou with a R&D team of about 100 person. At present we
have nearly 200 patents and authorized trademarks. Yonker also has three production bases cover an
area of 40000 square meters equipped with independent laboratories, testing centers, professional
intelligent SMT production lines, dust-free workshops, precision mold processing and injection
molding factories, forming a complete and cost-controllable production and quality control system.
The output is nearly 12 million units to meet the customized needs of global customers.

#### Introducing Zoe Medical

Zoe Medical, Inc. was founded in 1996, and has grown to become a recognized technology leader and
one of the largest manufacturers of patient monitoring systems in the United States.

Our substantial investment in R&D has fueled the introduction of many new products that benefit
customers in their everyday clinical work. Today, Zoe’s unique product architecture is running in
tens of thousands of installed units around the world. Our main office is located 30 miles north of
Boston in Topsfield, Massachusetts.

Most of our business has been designing and building products for other companies, including a
number of the world’s most highly regarded healthcare organizations. Zoe is now distributing
monitors and monitoring systems with our own label at factory direct prices. We invite you to learn
more about our products, and would love to talk with you about any of your patient monitoring needs!

Designed, manufactured, and supported in the USA

#### Introducing Zoe Medical

Zoe Medical, Inc. was founded in 1996, and has grown to become a recognized technology leader and
one of the largest manufacturers of patient monitoring systems in the United States.

Our substantial investment in R&D has fueled the introduction of many new products that benefit
customers in their everyday clinical work. Today, Zoe’s unique product architecture is running in
tens of thousands of installed units around the world. Our main office is located 30 miles north of
Boston in Topsfield, Massachusetts.

Most of our business has been designing and building products for other companies, including a
number of the world’s most highly regarded healthcare organizations. Zoe is now distributing
monitors and monitoring systems with our own label at factory direct prices. We invite you to learn
more about our products, and would love to talk with you about any of your patient monitoring needs!
